svg.title: The Rootbound Sanctum — review floor plan
svg.desc: Fourteen spaces. Start at the boat landing at the bottom. Choose the western shop branch or the eastern elite branch. Both join the sanctuary. The northern boss gates the exit. Cyan is a locked return shortcut, not an initial bypass.

g.title: 01 — Boat Landing: Arrive; learn movement without pressure.
02 — Sluice Gate: Introduce the first melee and ranged pairing.
03 — Root Court: First landmark encounter; reveal the route decision.
04 — Barracks: Practice flanking around low obstacles.
05 — Ember Smithy: Offer a predictable spending opportunity on the safer route.
06 — Hunter Cloister: Test target selection and pursuit.
07 — Quiet Sanctuary: Merge the routes and provide a one-use recovery offer.
08 — Flooded Archive: Offer a clearly signposted environmental risk.
09 — Blood Vault: Optional harder encounter that earns the branch reward.
10 — Sealed Spoils: Pay off the elite commitment before route convergence.
11 — Choir Hall: Final normal encounter; combine previously taught roles.
12 — Spore Grotto: A visually distinct finale with a Chieftain encounter.
13 — Hidden Cache: Reward exploration without making it mandatory.
14 — Ascent: Finish the floor and mark the next destination.
